preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= 10**18 for x in xs)
preconditions.description: Each test case input x is an integer between 1 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t integers, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= r for r in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(results[i] == max_k(xs[i]) for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case with input x, the output is the maximum number of distinct nice staircases that can be built using at most x cells in total, where a nice staircase with n stairs requires n*(n+1)/2 cells and n must be a power of 2 (i.e., n = 2^k for k >= 0), and the sum of cells used by the chosen distinct staircases does not exceed x.
